crm6 countries

Physics-based simulation of countries data. External data is just countries codes. Flag colors are embedded in the animation file.

Size: 393px × 852px
State Machine: State Machine 1
Artboard: main
Input: v_num:countries(16:1-200)
Input: v_num:countriesNew(16:1-99)
Input: txt:codes("WS CA MX GB GR ES BS CH TV TZ UY")
Input: txt:codesNew("AU CU JM HK MA TR US ZA TH WLS")
